data.name: HelpText
data.value: Mouse Acceleration sets how quickly the pointer moves; Finer Control shows a slider for values between the presets. Mouse Mapping swaps the buttons for a left hand. Click Speed is how quickly two clicks must come to count as a double click: click or double-click the Test button to try it. Changes apply as you make them, and Reset restores the settings from when this window opened. The Touchpad tab sets tapping, scrolling and how a touchpad with no buttons does the secondary click; Mouse Mapping and Click Speed apply to touchpads too.
